capabilities: File entries into year and month folders
Browse entries by timeline, list, and calendar
Generate a Markdown hub index note
extras: No network access or telemetry; interface in English and Spanish; requires Obsidian 1.15.0 or later; works on desktop and mobile; needs no other plugin (no Templater, no Dataview).
intentEvidence: Daily-notes plugins give you one note per day with a fixed name.
motivation: The author wanted a journal where each entry has its own name, maybe several per day, kept in a chosen folder and layout, with a way to browse entries and notice how often they actually write.
problem: Daily-notes plugins only create one fixed-name note per day, so keeping a named journal with several entries per day and browsing it means filing notes by hand.
summary: Journaling plugin that creates dated entries from templates, files them into year/month folders, and browses them in a timeline, calendar, and activity grid.
